annotation.title_clean: Part 850—Provisions Pertaining to U.S. Investments in Certain National Security Technologies and Products in Countries of Concern
annotation.title_en: Part 850—Provisions Pertaining to U.S. Investments in Certain National Security Technologies and Products in Countries of Concern
annotation.venue: Code of Federal Regulations (31 CFR Part 850) / Federal Register
annotation.summary_en: Treasury's final outbound investment rule (31 CFR Part 850) implementing E.O. 14105. It prohibits or requires notification of U.S. person investments in covered foreign persons in countries of concern working on semiconductors, quantum and AI. AI systems for robotic-system control, military or surveillance use, or high compute trigger notification or prohibition.
key_provisions_or_claims: U.S. persons may not engage in prohibited transactions involving advanced semiconductors, quantum, and certain AI systems in countries of concern.
Notification within 30 days is required for notifiable transactions, including AI systems intended for control of robotic systems, cybersecurity, or trained above 10^23 operations.
AI systems for military or mass-surveillance end use, or trained above 10^25 operations, are prohibited.
Knowledge standard based on reasonable and diligent inquiry; U.S. persons must prevent prohibited transactions by controlled foreign entities.
Enforcement under IEEPA with civil penalties up to the greater of $250,000 or twice the transaction value, criminal penalties, divestment, and voluntary self-disclosure.
